hypotheses.question: Why did the valuation comparator change?

alternatives.hypothesis: Ordinary revaluation after failed competition and market-price distortion
alternatives.test: Consistent independent methodologies, contemporaneous instructions and comparable-bank inputs support the revised comparator.

alternatives.hypothesis: Improper tailoring of the benchmark to a preferred bid
alternatives.test: Contemporaneous authorized records would need to show selective changes, conflicts, unequal treatment or departures from the published process.

alternatives.hypothesis: Apparent inconsistency caused by different dates, price concepts or missing records
alternatives.test: Reconcile reserve, fair-value benchmark, valuation dates, capital structure and bid conditions.

hypotheses.current_finding: Methodology change is disclosed; motivation and substantive fairness cannot be established from the press releases alone.
next_records: Original and revised valuer engagement terms and reports
Bid invitation revisions, equal-access notices and best-offer comparison
31 March 2026 audited accounts and disclosed peer inputs
hypotheses.stop_condition: Complete the named publicly accessible record set or log unavailable/confidential records. No inference of concealment from absence.
